matchPolicy.genderExceptionPolicy: If keeping a gender, hide only a strong matching character of another known canonical gender. Unknown, group-only, mixed and explicitly gender-swapped cases remain visible. A kept character always overrides a hide.
matchPolicy.ambiguousAliasPolicy: Contextual single-word/short-name aliases require a strong franchise or group cue in the same title.
matchPolicy.normalization: NFKD, diacritic-insensitive, casefold, punctuation/quote-insensitive, whole-token boundaries; split camelCase.
